uuid.description: Opaque lower-case UUID. Identifiers carry no meaning and are never parsed for one.

sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of an RFC8785 canonical form.

rfc3339Utc.description: UTC only, with optional fractional seconds. Note that these values must not be compared as strings even in this form: two valid instants differing only in fractional-second precision sort the wrong way round, because '.' (0x2E) is lower than 'Z' (0x5A). Consumers parse before comparing.

safeInteger.description: Within JSON safe-integer bounds; overflow is rejected rather than truncated.

atAction.description: The complete allowlist. These are AccessForge abstractions, not screen-reader library method names.
